outcome: intention to deliver by caesarean section
cohort: 1755 pregnant women in their first pregnancy and 590 in their second pregnancy in China
finding: Han nationality, older maternal age, second pregnancy and later trimester were associated with increased intention to deliver by caesarean section.
mod_finding: 8.89% of first-time mothers and 33.56% of second-time mothers intended to deliver by caesarean section.
